Before I finalize any authorization, I need input from each of your areas: treasury on cash positioning and funding, legal and compliance on any regulatory considerations, and investor relations on how the market might interpret different offer structures. The board has left the offer size, price, and execution method open, so I want to make sure we're thorough. What are you each seeing from your end?
